// diagnostic

E0613

Property-test (`#Test fn`) parameter has a type the runner can't generate

What

Property-test (`#Test fn`) parameter has a type the runner can't generate

Why

The property-test runner fills each parameter with generated values, so it needs a type it knows how to generate

Fix

Use only a property-test parameter type the runner can generate.
